name: SmartX Ingestion Opt C v1.0.2 -- Productionize DS Emit + Dead-Lambda Cleanup + 2nd-Producer Cross-Validation

Opt C v1.0.2 closes the gap permanently: (1) productionizes DS Base's emit as scheduled infrastructure (AE 0.7 picks Lambda+EventBridge cron OR SSM RunDocument scheduled OR equivalent); (2) cleans dead Lambda code + retires unused IAM grants; (3) ships a 2nd-producer cross-validation gate (defense layer cross-checking the new SoT producer against an independent reference, fail-LOUD on divergence) -- mirrors the masking-class memory rider 2 framing (single-producer brittleness; second-producer cross-check catches cohort-level errors that identity_1 mask). Acceleration to FIRST in AE 0.7 post-v1.0.1 queue per CTO 2026-05-19 disposition -- active-staleness (legacy file daily-stale without daily-fire) beats preventive-defense (ADHC_DSFLOW.007 + ADVI_INFALM.001 push by ~0.5d, no broken dependencies, both independent infrastructure on different pipelines).
